content: Wani Ti'ɨyame kemɨtikuxatakai

Merikɨtsɨ 'ana Tiweriyu Tsetsaxi tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi wiyari kaniyuriekaitɨni ti'aitatɨ, Punitsiyu Piratu kuwexinaruri kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni Kureya kwieyaritsie, Herurexi kanihɨritɨariekaitɨni Karereya kwieyaritsie mɨti'aitanikɨ, Peripe Herurexi mɨ'iwayatɨkai katini'aitakaitɨni 'Itureya kwieyaritsie meta Tɨrakuniti kwieyaritsie, meta Ritsaniyaxi katini'aitakaitɨni 'Awiriniyatsie,
'Anátsi meta Kaipátsi mekanihɨritɨariekaitɨni mawari wewiwamete. 'Ana Kakaɨyari yuniuki Wani kaniupitɨani Tsakariyaxi nu'aya, makumawetsie 'uyeikakaku.

Wani naitsarie Kurutani hatuxameyari manuyeka kaniuyeikakaitɨni, mɨpaɨ tikuxatatɨ teɨteri memɨtehayewakɨ 'axameteyurietɨ meta memɨka'ɨyarienikɨ mɨpaɨ mɨtimatsiɨkɨnikɨ kename mete'uhayewaxɨ 'axameteyurietɨ.
Yakatiniyurienekaitɨni kemɨre'uxa Kitsariyaxi xapayaritsie, Kakaɨyari niukieyakɨ kemɨtikuxatakai:
Wani mɨpaɨ katiniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni teɨteri memɨ'axekai mɨwaka'ɨyakɨ: —Kuterixi waniwema. ¿Kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ pɨtixe'utahɨawixɨ xemɨyuta'unakɨ kapa 'uxa'atɨniwarie xe'uyehekarienikɨ?

Mɨkɨ memɨte'uhayewaxɨ kememɨteyurie wahepaɨ xeketeneyurieka, kemɨreuyewetse. Xepɨka'itsutɨaka yu'iyaritsie mɨpaɨ xeteyɨkɨhɨawetɨ: “Tepɨnaki'eriwa ta'ukiyari temexeiyakɨ 'Apɨrahami”. Mɨpaɨ nepɨtixekɨhɨawe, Kakaɨyari kaniyɨweni 'ikɨ tetexi teɨteri mɨwarayeitɨani 'Apɨrahami niwemama.
'Ari hatsa kaniukuha'aritɨarieni kɨyexi maxɨrienikɨ, 'ayumieme naitɨ kɨye 'aixɨa 'anenetɨ mɨka'utixuxuawere kanaxɨriyamɨkɨ, taipa kaneuxɨriyamɨkɨ.
Teɨteri mɨpaɨ mekateniku'iwawiyakaitɨni: —¿Kamɨtsɨ keteteyurieka?
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe Wani: —Kemɨ'ane huta kamixayari mexeiya, kemɨ'ane mɨkaheixeiya ke'umini, kemɨ'ane 'ikwai mexeiya yaxeikɨa ketiyurieneni.
Meta kuwiyexinu hetsiemieme tewawamete mekaniu'axɨani, memɨka'ɨyarienikɨ. Mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —Ti'ɨkitame 'aku, ¿keteteyurieka tame?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kexemɨte'u'aitɨarie, heimana mieme xepɨkatewauka.
Meta kuyaxi mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —Tameta, ¿keteteyurieka? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xepɨkatenawayani, 'itarikakɨ xepɨkawatawiwiyani. Xekenenaki'aka yu'iwarikakɨ.
Merikɨtsɨ 'ana teɨteri mekanita'ikwewakaitɨni yu'iyaritsie meyu'iyaritɨatɨ yunaitɨ Wani hepaɨtsita, xɨka mɨkɨ Kɨritsitu hɨkɨtɨni mexɨka katixaɨtɨni, me'utiyuatɨ.

Peru Wani mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yunaime: —Neri hakɨ nepɨxe'uka'ɨya. Peru 'ukanamieni kemɨ'ane waɨkawa mɨtɨrɨkaɨye, nekatɨrɨkaɨyekaku ne. 'Aixɨa nepɨka'ane nehetsie mɨtinakenikɨ nemiparewiekakɨ ninemenakuwenirienikɨ kakaiya kwitaxiyari. Mɨkɨ pɨta kanixeka'ɨyamɨkɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ meta kanixe'itimɨkɨ tai kemɨtiyu'itiwa.
Kuxari 'itiwame pakwe'e, tɨriku mɨti'itienikɨ kuxari manuyewiwienikɨ, tɨriku kaniti'utamɨkɨ kaxetunitsie, peru kuxariyari pɨta pɨtitaiya tai mɨkatɨwetsie.
Matsi waɨkawa kaniwatuikakaitɨni teɨteri, niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne kaniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni.

Hikɨ Herurexi mɨkɨ kwieyari kanihɨritɨariekaitɨni mana mɨti'aitanikɨ. Yu'iwa kaniu'ɨyapieni, Heruriya titewakame kaniutiwitɨni, waɨkawa katiniyurienekaitɨni Herurexi 'axatiyurienetɨ, 'ayumieme Wani kanitate'akaitɨni.
Hikɨ Herurexi nayuye'atɨani 'axakemɨtiyurienekai, Wani kananutahɨani katsariyanata.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiuka'ɨyarie meta nuiwarieya
Merikɨtsɨ kepauka yunaitɨ teɨteri memuka'ɨyarie, Ketsutsi kaniuka'ɨyarienita. Mexi yunenewiekai, taheima kananakatenire,

'Iyari Mɨtiyupata heimana kanakaneni hetsiena kaninuani, kukuru hepaɨ katiniyuxexeiyakaitɨni. Hikɨ xewitɨta taheima mɨpaɨ kanetayɨni: «'Ekɨ pekanineniwetɨni nekamaninaki'erieka, 'akɨmana nekaniyutemawieka».
Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi xeitewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari yakɨtɨtɨ kanihɨkaitɨni kepauka mitsutɨa mɨpaɨ tiyurienetɨ. Kutse kaninu'ayatɨkaitɨni, mekateniku'eriwakaitɨni,
